title: Kool-Aid Man OH YEAH
blurb: He has never once used a door and has shown no interest whatsoever in learning. The Kool-Aid Man's catchphrase arrives simultaneously with the destruction of a load-bearing wall, which is a remarkable thing for a children's beverage mascot to have built a reputation on. As an audio cue it is perfect for unexpected entrances, uninvited opinions, and anyone joining a conversation via maximum property damage. Structurally irresponsible, spiritually correct, and beloved by generations who accepted without question that a giant jug would be arriving through the brickwork.
origin: The Kool-Aid Man's iconic wall-smashing catchphrase.
